__inputs.name: DS_GO_STATIONS
__inputs.label: Cloudflare Analytics Engine
__inputs.description: The Altinity ClickHouse data source pointed at Analytics Engine's SQL API (docs/WATCHER.md)

title: GO Stations: how close trains are drawn
description: The watcher's scoreboard (worker/src/watch.js): each way of drawing a train, against where the train really was.

panels.title: Today: metres off
panels.description: Build 148's drawing (10 s behind): how far, on average, from where the train really was.

targets.query: SELECT SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'today' AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}'
targets.rawQuery: SELECT SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'today' AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}'

panels.title: Option A: metres off
panels.description: Guessed on from each GPS fix's own time, gliding to each new fix in 2 s.

targets.query: SELECT SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'from_fix' AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}'
targets.rawQuery: SELECT SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'from_fix' AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}'

panels.title: Option A: time ahead of the train
panels.description: Share of seconds drawn more than 1 m ahead of the real train.

targets.query: SELECT 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double5) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'from_fix' AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}'
targets.rawQuery: SELECT 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double5) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'from_fix' AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}'

panels.title: Newest fix only: metres off
panels.description: Where the newest GPS fix has the train: how stale the raw data is.

targets.query: SELECT SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'newest' AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}'
targets.rawQuery: SELECT SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'newest' AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}'

panels.title: How far off each way of drawing a train is
panels.description: Mean distance along the track between where each model draws a train and where the train really was (read off all its GPS fixes afterwards).

targets.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t
targets.rawQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t

properties.value: Option A: from each fix's time

panels.title: Behind (below 0) or ahead (above 0)
panels.description: Mean signed error: negative is behind the real train, positive ahead.

targets.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, SUM(_sample_interval * double3) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t
targets.rawQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, SUM(_sample_interval * double3) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t

properties.value: Option A: from each fix's time

panels.title: Time ahead of the train
panels.description: Share of seconds drawn more than 1 m ahead of where the train really was.

targets.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double5) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t
targets.rawQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double5) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t

properties.value: Option A: from each fix's time

panels.title: Time off by over 100 m
panels.description: Share of seconds drawn more than 100 m from the real train, either way.

targets.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double13) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t
targets.rawQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double13) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t

properties.value: Option A: from each fix's time

panels.title: Moves back, per hour of a train in view
panels.description: How often a drawn train moves backwards (a correction a rider can see), per hour of train time.

targets.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, 3600 * SUM(_sample_interval * double9) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t
targets.rawQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS model, 3600 * SUM(_sample_interval * double9) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY t, model ORDER BY t

properties.value: Option A: from each fix's time

panels.title: By hour of the day (Toronto): metres off
panels.description: Mean metres off by the hour of the day, Toronto time.

targets.query: SELECT blob7 AS hour, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'today') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'today') AS today, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'from_fix') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'from_fix') AS from_fix, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'newest') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'newest') AS newest FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
targets.rawQuery: SELECT blob7 AS hour, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'today') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'today') AS today, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'from_fix') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'from_fix') AS from_fix, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'newest') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'newest') AS newest FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

properties.value: Option A: from each fix's time

panels.title: By what the train is doing: metres off
panels.description: stand: standing; in: within 1.5 km of a station it stops at; out: within 1.5 km after leaving one; run: in between.

targets.query: SELECT blob3 AS phase, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'today') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'today') AS today, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'from_fix') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'from_fix') AS from_fix, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'newest') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'newest') AS newest FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' GROUP BY phase ORDER BY phase
targets.rawQuery: SELECT blob3 AS phase, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'today') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'today') AS today, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'from_fix') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'from_fix') AS from_fix, sumIf(_sample_interval * double2, blob1 = 'newest') / sumIf(_sample_interval * double1, blob1 = 'newest') AS newest FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' GROUP BY phase ORDER BY phase

properties.value: Option A: from each fix's time

panels.title: By line
panels.description: Each line, each model, over the time range.

targets.query: SELECT blob2 AS line, blob1 AS model, SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS metres_off, SUM(_sample_interval * double3) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS signed, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double5) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS ahead_pct, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double13) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS over_100m_pct, 3600 * SUM(_sample_interval * double9) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS back_per_hour, SUM(_sample_interval * double1) / 3600 AS train_hours FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY line, model ORDER BY line, model
targets.rawQuery: SELECT blob2 AS line, blob1 AS model, SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS metres_off, SUM(_sample_interval * double3) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS signed, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double5) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS ahead_pct, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double13) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS over_100m_pct, 3600 * SUM(_sample_interval * double9) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS back_per_hour, SUM(_sample_interval * double1) / 3600 AS train_hours FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' GROUP BY line, model ORDER BY line, model

panels.title: Stations where today's model is furthest off
panels.description: By the station each train was heading for (or standing at), with at least 12 minutes of train time.

targets.query: SELECT blob4 AS station, SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS metres_off, SUM(_sample_interval * double3) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS signed, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double5) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS ahead_pct, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double13) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS over_100m_pct, 3600 * SUM(_sample_interval * double9) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS back_per_hour, SUM(_sample_interval * double1) / 3600 AS train_hours FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' AND blob1 = 'today' GROUP BY station HAVING train_hours > 0.2 ORDER BY metres_off DESC LIMIT 15
targets.rawQuery: SELECT blob4 AS station, SUM(_sample_interval * double2) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS metres_off, SUM(_sample_interval * double3) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS signed, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double5) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS ahead_pct, 100 * SUM(_sample_interval * double13) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS over_100m_pct, 3600 * SUM(_sample_interval * double9) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS back_per_hour, SUM(_sample_interval * double1) / 3600 AS train_hours FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' AND blob1 = 'today' GROUP BY station HAVING train_hours > 0.2 ORDER BY metres_off DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Worst minutes: furthest behind (today's model)
panels.description: The train-minutes where today's model fell furthest behind. (Each row lands about a minute after the minute it scores.)

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, blob5 AS trip, blob2 AS line, blob4 AS station, blob3 AS phase, double8 AS most_behind, double2 / double1 AS metres_off, double1 AS seconds FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' AND blob1 = 'today' ORDER BY most_behind DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawQuery: SELECT timestamp, blob5 AS trip, blob2 AS line, blob4 AS station, blob3 AS phase, double8 AS most_behind, double2 / double1 AS metres_off, double1 AS seconds FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' AND blob1 = 'today' ORDER BY most_behind DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Worst minutes: furthest ahead (any model)
panels.description: The train-minutes where a model drew a train furthest ahead of where it really was.

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, blob1 AS model, blob5 AS trip, blob2 AS line, blob4 AS station, blob3 AS phase, double7 AS most_ahead, double2 / double1 AS metres_off, double1 AS seconds FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' ORDER BY most_ahead DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawQuery: SELECT timestamp, blob1 AS model, blob5 AS trip, blob2 AS line, blob4 AS station, blob3 AS phase, double7 AS most_ahead, double2 / double1 AS metres_off, double1 AS seconds FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' ORDER BY most_ahead DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: How old the newest fix is, as the app has it
panels.description: Mean age of the newest GPS fix the app had, in seconds (including the app's own lag).

targets.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, 'fix age' AS series, SUM(_sample_interval * double14) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' AND blob1 = 'newest' GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t
targets.rawQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, 'fix age' AS series, SUM(_sample_interval * double14) / SUM(_sample_interval * double1) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' AND blob1 = 'newest' GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

panels.title: Trains being scored
panels.description: Trains scored at once, on average over each bucket (train-seconds scored / seconds).

targets.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, 'trains' AS series, SUM(_sample_interval * double1) / ($interval) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' AND blob1 = 'today' GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t
targets.rawQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, 'trains' AS series, SUM(_sample_interval * double1) / ($interval) AS value FROM go_stations_scores WHERE $timeFilter AND blob2 LIKE '${line}' AND blob3 LIKE '${phase}' AND blob1 = 'today' GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t
